queries: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count FROM media_stats

WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_of_media_type_averages, AVG(track_count) AS avg_tracks_per_media_type FROM per_media_type

WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM per_media_type;

responses.sql: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count FROM media_stats

assumptions.assumption: A track with zero milliseconds has an undefined bytes-per-millisecond value, so it is excluded from that average but included in the track count.

responses.sql: WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_of_media_type_averages, AVG(track_count) AS avg_tracks_per_media_type FROM per_media_type

assumptions.assumption: Each media type with at least one qualifying track contributes equally to the final averages.

responses.sql: WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM per_media_type;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with zero milliseconds, if any, count toward their media type's track count but have no defined bytes-per-millisecond value and are excluded from that average.
